parsed.post: Kept WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1: val_bpb 1.0303 -> 1.0294. A small improvement. Many teammates are finding success by halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps. Next: halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to see if more updates per 5-min budget improve convergence.
